description: Grain Statistics Weekly is the Canadian Grain Commission's weekly series on how grain moves through the country's handling system. The page read on 2026-09-28 describes data on weekly and crop-year-to-date movements of the principal grains and oilseeds from Canadian farms to domestic processing and export, stocks held in commercial facilities, and feed grain handlings. For the 2026 to 2027 crop year it offers a cumulative CSV file in open data format, about 15 MB and extended every week, and one spreadsheet per week, from the week ending 9 August 2026 onward, with a link to archived historical crop years. Coverage is Canada, for grain moving from farms into commercial handling. Access is free; no licence is stated on the page. Caveats: the facility types, regions and grain grades behind the tables were not inspected, and the archive was not opened. It supports supply chain and capacity studies, such as modelling weekly flows from country elevators to terminal ports to see how a rail or port disruption would build up stocks. Related record: the CONAB storage and harvest portal for Brazil.
